# @suluk/models

> A weekly, PUBLIC-DATA-ONLY catalog of OpenRouter models + a selector: a suluk skill declares NEEDS (hard filters) + a small PREFERENCE (a named profile), and selectModel picks the best CURRENT model — never a hard-coded id. Decidable OpenRouter facts as numbers; noisy benchmarks as COARSE TIERS with {source, asOf}; no cross-axis composite (blending is the selector's job). CANDIDATE tooling — NOT official OAS.

> Reference tooling for the OpenAPI v4.0 Suluk candidate.

### API

- `selectModel`
- `deriveRequirements`: Derive HardFilters from an agent/skill's declared needs + the analyzer's load (the C027 seam).
- `applyBucketing`: Bucket a raw leaderboard score into a coarse tier per the committed rule. Null/absent/unknown-axis ⇒ `unknown`.
- `normalizeOpenRouter`
- `normalizeOpenRouterModel`: One OpenRouter model → its decidable fact cells (intel/gov tiers stay UNKNOWN; filled by the Class-B pass).
- `catalogFrom`
- `snapshotHash`: A content-addressed hash over the rows' load-bearing SELECTION inputs — facts AND intel tiers (a re-pick under a
different catalog must differ; rep...
- `fetchOpenRouterCatalog`: Fetch OpenRouter `/models` and normalize to the fact-cell catalog. NETWORK — run from a weekly script/CI, not tests.
- `applyTierOverlay`: Overlay coarse tiers onto matching rows' intel cells, then re-hash (selection now depends on these tiers).
- `OPENROUTER_CATALOG`
- `SEED_CATALOG`: Illustrative seed — NOT the live catalog. Tiers reflect coarse public standing as of asOf; UNKNOWN is honest.
- `PROFILES`
- `BUCKETING_RULES`
- `KNOWN_TIERS`: A SMALL, conservatively-CITED seed of coarse public standings for headline frontier models (the bootstrap until
the full Class-B curation lands).

## Optional

### Types

- `Tier`: `@suluk/models` — the catalog schema (council wf_729cde52-cc7).
- `Cell`: One catalog value with provenance. `value: null` ⇒ UNKNOWN (and `source` is ""); never imputed.
- `DataRetention`
- `ModelRecord`
- `ModelCatalog`
- `HardFilters`: Hard requirements — these FILTER (can empty the set ⇒ fail-loud), never rank.
- `Profile`
- `Preferences`: Preference — RANKS the survivors. A named profile is the 90% case; the escape hatch is ≤4 small int weights.
- `RankedModel`
- `SelectResult`
- `ResolvedProfile`
- `AxisRule`
- `ORModel`: The subset of an OpenRouter `/models` row we rely on (all public facts).
- `IntelAxis`
